(FOR ADMISSION and I.R.
 IA No. 29404/2025 - CONDONATION OF DELAY IN REFILING / CUR  DEFECTS)
 Date : 10-02-2025
This matter was called on for hearing today.
CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE K.V. VISWANATHAN  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE NONGMEIKAPAM KOTISWAR SINGH

For Petitioner(s) :
 Mr. Neeraj Kishan Kaul, Sr. Adv.
 Mr. Shubhranshu Padhi, AOR  Mr. Akshay Pradhan, Adv.
 Mr. Jay Nirupam, Adv.

For Respondent(s) :
 UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R 1.

2. Mr. Neeraj Kishan Kaul, learned senior counsel contends that notwithstanding the liberty given under the order of this Court dated 07.10.2016 (Page No. 46), an error has occurred in approaching the High Court for the very same relief which was concluded by the earlier round.

His limited prayer in the petition is that the petitioner should be given compensation under the Right to Fair Compensation & Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Bablu vs State Of Uttarakhand on 10 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/80320742/
1 Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
3. To consider this submission, issue notice to the respondents.
4. Liberty to serve the Standing Counsel for the State of Uttarakhand.
